text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara pulled off a splendid run
and left her mark on the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

And so, one day while still basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, here comes today's star of the show!
'The Umamusume who kept winning against herself', Haru Urara!”

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! Yep,
I'm Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chaaan!
You're super cute today too!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yo, we've been waiting for ya!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah, there's so many people!
Welcome, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did you mean to say "Welcome"?
Oh well, whatever works!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Today is the "Haru Urara Fan Club" meeting after all!
I'm the king here~!

"Yes. Today, Haru Urara attended
a talk show hosted by her fan club."

A huge crowd had gathered in the small shopping district
just to catch a glimpse of Haru Urara.
Among them was—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, who are you calling a King?!
The only one worthy of bearing that title is I—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, what's the harm?
Let's just say Urara gets to be King for today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Urara-chaaan!
Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Come on, you too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
Urara-chan, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waah, waaah~~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You all came too!
Thank you so much!
My friends at Tracen Academy, and—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chaaan!!
There's no need to be nervous!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text: "Smile like you always do! And speak with all your energy!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, thank you!
I'll do my best!

The folks from the shopping district who had always
supported Haru Urara closed up shop temporarily
just to come watch her.

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Urara-san, so many people came
to see you today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I'm super happy!
Everyone came to see me, didn't they!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, that means you saw how hard I was running, right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Today is such a happy day!
Everyone is smiling, and I'm so, so happy!

Haru Urara's smile was warm like spring sunshine.
That smile captivated countless people.

And...
the sight of you never giving up!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Haru Urara, let's jump right into the questions.
Looking back, how were these past three years for you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm... huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember stuff from three years ago~.
Hmm, let's see... was I running back then?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I was running the whole time!
And then, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
Excuse me for a moment!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text: H-Haru Urara-san!?

Haru Urara jumped down from the stage!
And now she's heading straight towards me...!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, come with me!
Let's go have a chat!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Come to think of it, Trainer has to be there too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Because Trainer is the one who's been watching me
this whole three years!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're the only one
who knows every single bit of how hard I ran and tried!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
“If we're talking about me,
Trainer's gotta be here!”

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Come on, take my hand!
Let's run—together!
